content.text: {"rows":[{"source_id":"id02086","target":"— Решительно, — сказал д’Артаньян, — мне нравится эта проза, и кардинал пишет лучше, чем я думал. Ну что же, Планше, отправимся с визитом к господину казначею короля, а потом пришпорим коней."},{"source_id":"id02087","target":"— В сторону Парижа, сударь."},{"source_id":"id02088","target":"— В сторону Парижа."},{"source_id":"id02089","target":"И оба пустились самой быстрой рысью, на какую были способны их лошади."}],"review":[{"source_id":"id02086","verdict":"PASS","reason":"Faithful to the French. \"Décidément\", the praise of the cardinal's prose, the plan to visit the king's treasurer and then \"piquons\" (spur on) are all rendered accurately, and the register is idiomatic. No omissions or additions."},{"source_id":"id02087","verdict":"PASS","reason":"\"Vers Paris, monsieur\" is rendered accurately as the reply with the polite address \"сударь\". The dialogue dash is correct."},{"source_id":"id02088","verdict":"PASS","reason":"D'Artagnan's echo \"Vers Paris\" is preserved as a separate dialogue turn, with wording consistent with the previous row."},{"source_id":"id02089","verdict":"PASS","reason":"\"Tous deux partirent au plus grand trot de leurs montures\" is conveyed faithfully: both set off at the fastest trot their mounts could manage. The phrasing is slightly expanded but adds no fact, and it reads idiomatically."}]}
